cover.hook: Canada just approved a $70B nickel mine in Northern Ontario — and AI costs hit a new floor.
cover.sub: Plus: EU AI fines go live, US 50% tariffs on Canadian plywood land August 19, and NWO fires: 1,876 evacuees remain.

reelSub: A $70B mine, EU AI enforcement, and frontier AI at $0.20 per million tokens — this week in the Northwest.
storySub: Five moves this week that matter for Northern Ontario businesses and operators.

items.title: Canada approves a $70B nickel mine in Northern Ontario
items.body: Canada Nickel's Crawford Project — world's second-largest nickel reserves — got federal approval July 31. $5B investment, 5,000 construction jobs, 41-year mine life. First major Northern Ontario mine through the amended Impact Assessment Act.
items.tease: Next: the US tariff hitting Canadian plywood on August 19.
items.reelLine: Crawford Nickel gets federal approval: $5B investment, 5,000 jobs, $70B projected GDP impact for Northern Ontario.

items.title: US 50% tariffs on Canadian plywood and paper: two weeks out
items.body: New 50% US tariffs cover MDF, plywood, veneer panels, paper, and furniture components — effective August 19. Lumber under existing Section 232 duties is exempt. NWO wood composite and paper facilities are directly in scope.
items.tease: Next: the EU just activated its AI penalty machine.
items.reelLine: US 50% tariffs on Canadian plywood, MDF, and paper products land August 19 — NWO mills are in scope.

items.title: EU AI Act enforcement is live — reaches Canadian companies
items.body: As of August 2, the EU can fine AI providers up to 3% of global revenue or 35M euros for prohibited practices. The Act covers any company serving EU customers, regardless of where it is headquartered.
items.tease: Next: frontier AI just dropped to $0.20 per million tokens.
items.reelLine: EU AI Act enforcement activated August 2 — fines up to 3% of global revenue now apply to companies worldwide.

items.title: OpenAI cuts GPT-5.6 Luna to $0.20 per million tokens
items.body: An 80% price drop on July 30 brings frontier-generation AI to small-business price levels. At typical usage volumes, that is low single-digit monthly costs. Competition from Anthropic and others is driving AI costs down fast.
items.tease: Next: NWO wildfire evacuees and what it means for communities.
items.reelLine: OpenAI cut GPT-5.6 Luna 80% to $0.20 per million tokens — frontier AI now at small-business prices.

items.title: NWO wildfire evacuees fall to 1,876; 8 new fires on August 1
items.body: Evacuee count dropped from 2,800+ to 1,876 — real progress, but 130 fires remained active August 2 and 8 new fires started on August 1. Road closures on Highways 811 and 527 remain in effect.
items.reelLine: NWO wildfire evacuees fall to 1,876 — but 130 fires remain active and 8 new ones started August 1.

summary.title: Critical minerals unlocked, AI costs at record lows, new penalties live, and trade tariffs two weeks out
summary.body: A $70B mine cleared the regulatory gate, frontier AI costs hit record lows, EU enforcement penalties went live, US tariffs on Canadian plywood and paper land in two weeks, and Northern Ontario's wildfire season continues its long-tail recovery.

captions.carousel: Canada Nickel's Crawford mine near Timmins received federal approval July 31 — the world's second-largest nickel reserves, $5 billion in investment, 5,000 construction jobs, and the first major mining project through Canada's amended Impact Assessment Act. US 50% tariffs on Canadian plywood, MDF, and paper products were confirmed effective August 19, putting NWO wood composite and paper facilities directly in scope. As of August 2, the EU AI Act's enforcement powers are active — the EU can now fine AI providers up to 3% of global revenue, and the Act reaches any company serving EU customers. On July 30, OpenAI cut GPT-5.6 Luna by 80% to $0.20 per million tokens, making frontier-generation AI practical at small-business cost levels. And NWO wildfire evacuee counts fell from 2,800+ to 1,876, though 130 fires remained active and 8 new ones started August 1.
